item.title: Drawing in the Browser with HTML5 Canvas
item.description: Most of our web development work revolves around HTML tags: boxes, lists, buttons, and paragraphs. Every now and then, though, you want to build something purely visual: a chart generator, an interactive particle background, or even a mini 2D browser game. :D That’s where the HTML5 <canvas> API comes alive. Instead of manipulating DOM tree elements, canvas gives you an immediate-mode pixel sandbox where you paint shapes and colors using pure JavaScript code.
